sloka: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना यस्मात्त्वमनवस्थिता ।तस्माद्रूपवती लोके न त्वमेका भविष्यति ।। ७.३०.३८ ॥
transliteration: rūpayauvanasampannā yasmāttvamanavasthitā ।tasmādrūpavatī loke na tvamekā bhaviṣyati ।। 7.30.38 ॥

translations.english: Because you, endowed with beauty and youth, are unstable, therefore you will not be the only beautiful woman in the world.
